rows.reply: Aarav, tumne sticks aur clay balls ke liye apni ginti batayi. Ab card par diye choices mein se ek chun lo. Sticks edges hain aur goliyan corners. Kitni sticks aur kitni goliyan chahiye?

rows.said: Mujhe nahi pata, ek baar aur batao na.
rows.heard: मुझे नहीं पता। एक बार और बताओ ना।
rows.reply: Aarav, cube ko dheere se dekho. Har stick ek edge par lagti hai, aur har clay ball ek corner par. Sticks edges hain aur goliyan corners. Kitni sticks aur kitni goliyan chahiye?
